newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombian industrialist group says output up.
newsitem.headline: Colombian industrialist group says output up.

text.p: Industrial output grew 4 percent in January this year compared to the same period in 1996, according to the latest survey by the influential National Industrialists Association (ANDI).
The organization's Industrial Opinion Survey showed sales had also grown 4.3 percent in January compared to January 1996.
"Although the situation is still unfavorable there is a certain improvement," a statement issued by ANDI read.
It added that the industrial output was pushed up by growth in the metallurgy and paper sectors and that in the corresponding month of 1996 industrial output had fallen 3.2 percent.

The ANDI poll said industrialists' main worries remained the same, with 28.4 percent of those polled complaining of lack of demand, 11.2 percent complaining of slow payment for goods and 10 percent complaining of high financial costs.
